verdict.rationale: Logseq exposes a plugin API and a local HTTP API for external access to the graph (logseq-docs-6, logseq-docs-21, logseq-docs-29), but the plugin API reference is explicitly community-driven rather than an official first-party SDK (logseq-docs-12), and probes found no OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt for machine-readable API discovery (logseq-probe-1, logseq-probe-2). missing for 10: an official, versioned SDK/API reference maintained by Logseq itself, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), and AI-discovery metadata (llms.txt).
